envelope.comment: Rewrote ingest/records.py to implement the snake_case normalization contract: camelCase keys are converted to snake_case and unknown keys are dropped, satisfying the failing tests.

The normalize function in ingest/records.py currently only returns a shallow copy of the input dict, which preserves camelCase keys and unknown keys. To fix the bug, it must convert camelCase keys to snake_case and drop unknown keys, but no valid implementation can satisfy the failing tests while keeping the file unchanged.
Rewrote ingest/records.py so normalize() converts camelCase keys to snake_case and drops unknown keys, satisfying the snake_case wire contract and the failing tests.
